title: Center Console Switch-Tab Repair Kit for Porsche 911 964 and 993
notes: One STL designed to retain with the original spring clamp. Strong non-critical pilot lead, but fitment is asserted by the archive and has not been independently checked on a 993 console. 2026-10-15: same asset as SRC-PRINTABLES-964-993-CONSOLE-SWITCH-TAB (Printables model 1369571). On 2026-10-15 the original Printables page (model 1369571) was not readable: printables.com/robots.txt allows all agents except /world/, but the model page returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare JavaScript challenge ('Enable JavaScript and cookies to continue') to both the page-reading tool and a plain HTTP client. The Internet Archive index lists a capture of that page dated 2025-09-12 (HTTP 200); it was not read, because the page-reading tool refuses web.archive.org. The CC-BY (no version) statement rests only on the secondary archive, so redistribution is set to unknown, as for every Renn 3D Parts record, until the licence is read on the original page.
